name: Nut

skills.name: Celestial Starfall
skills.description: Nut ascends to gather stellar power for 5s, charging up to 500 Energy. Once charging is complete or interrupted, deals 500% ATK as AoE DMG to targets in a dense area and clears all Energy. For every Energy accumulated, her DMG multiplier increases by 2%.

upgrades.level2: Nut gains 50% Dodge Rate during the charge-up.
upgrades.level3: For every Energy accumulated, the DMG multiplier increases by 3%.
upgrades.level4: For every Energy accumulated, the DMG multiplier increases by 4%.

skills.name: Stardust Volley
skills.description: Summons 3 small star cores and fires them sequentially at a dense enemy AoE, dealing DMG equal to 80% ATK to enemies within range.

upgrades.level3: Also reduces the targets' M-RES by 20%.

skills.name: Starcore Aegis
skills.description: At the start of battle, Nut summons a star core to protect herself, gaining a Shield equal to 20% of her max HP, and enters a continuous casting state. During this time, she gains 140 Energy per sec and a small star core rotating around her. Each small star core provides Nut with 20% ATK.

upgrades.level2: Gains a Shield equal to 30% of her max HP.
upgrades.level4: Each small star core provides Nut with 30% ATK.

skills.name: Astral Repulse
skills.description: Passive: When any enemy unit approaches Nut, deals DMG equal to 100% ATK to the surrounding area and knocks back hit units. CD: 20s.

relic.name: Celestial Covenant
relic.description: [Celestial Starfall] Nut restores 30 Energy per sec during the charge-up.

upgrades.level2: [Astral Repulse] When cast, also becomes untargetable for 3s.
upgrades.level3: [Celestial Starfall] Nut restores 60 Energy per sec during the charge-up.

strengths: Self-sufficient energy: ult-ready in ~2.5-3s of peace - no battery hero required
Interruption only discounts her ult; full denial is nearly impossible
Self-ramping ATK: every orbiting core adds +30% ATK to her own detonation - not a team buff
Layered escape chain: shield - knockback - dodge - untargetable
Can make a difference even with high difference in BP or level
weaknesses: Zero team utility - her ramp buffs only herself; if the bomb never lands, she contributed nothing
Hard CC before the charge state is her real kill window
Beware of ATK-locking Assassins or divers that could target her easily cause of her ATK-ramping
Knockback answers one diver per 14s - double-dive walks through it
Weak against a solo boss - her damage is mediocre cause of her cycle
Ceiling is relic-gated: untargetable at R10, 1,000-cap at R30 - long investment curve
